name: Shizuka Hearing
description: Shizuka Hearing is a WordPress block theme for a calm audiology clinic serving adults who strain to follow conversation in noise. The fictional practice was founded in 2014 at 18 Harbour Lane, Northgate, and publishes its hearing check, real-ear fitting, tinnitus care, and review fees in euros. The copy follows a visit from the missed sentence through measurement, a 14-day home trial, and later review.
